title: Book Two · Chapter 188: The New Packet
story:
The test packet has three pages. Ronan checks the number at the top of each one before he begins. No page is missing.

The first gives the usual reading room times. The second changes one afternoon because younger students will use the room. The third is a plan. It shows a front desk and a return shelf. A smaller room is beside the garden.

Ronan reads the visitor's card. The visitor is a younger student. He needs to collect a picture packet on the changed afternoon. He also wants to return a book for his older sister.

There are two different needs. Ronan writes collect and return on his rough paper. He puts a short line between them.

The packet collection moves to the smaller room. The return shelf stays beside the front desk. The main reading room is closed to older students for that afternoon only.

He checks the dates on both notices. The change is for the same day as the visitor's card.

Around him, pencils move. A student coughs. Ronan keeps his eyes on his own pages.

He answers the first questions. Then he sees a small number beside the picture packet. The visitor needs that number to collect it. Ronan adds it to his explanation.

He has almost finished when he notices his own arrow. It goes from the front desk through the main reading room. But the packet instructions give a different entrance.

He reads the garden entrance line. The smaller room has its own outside door. He crosses out his arrow and draws a new one from the garden path.

There is still time. He imagines he is the younger visitor. He reads each step. First, return the book at the shelf. Then go outside and take the garden path. Collect the packet at the smaller room. Give the collection number at that desk.

He checks each step against the three pages.

At the bottom, a question asks about a lost collection card. The packet does not explain this problem. Ronan writes that the visitor needs to ask the teacher at the front desk. He does not make up a new rule.

Miss Wu calls time. Ronan puts down his pencil. The last answer is complete. His rough paper still has the old arrow, clearly crossed out.

He hands in all three pages and the answer sheet. He did the whole task alone. No friend found an important line for him.

Outside, he takes a drink of water. The next part is spoken. He has ten minutes before his turn.

He wants to ask another student about the packet. He moves away from the doorway instead and watches two birds beside the yard wall. One bird gets a crumb. The other has to keep looking. Ronan waits until his name is called.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

rough paper＝草稿纸；route＝路线；make up＝编造；against＝对照。

## 理解问题

1. 来访者的两项需要分别在哪里办理？
2. 不论来访者年龄，领取资料包应走哪个入口？Ronan怎样改正自己的箭头？

## 读句子

**Ronan puts down his pencil.**

拆开看：Ronan / puts down / his pencil.

Ronan／放下／铅笔。
